title: AICMS 1.0 — Official Launch!
content:
AICMS 1.0 is a file-based CMS without a database, with a built-in AI assistant and Lumina editor.

Key Features

  • File-based storage (JSON) — no MySQL required
  • AI generation of text, images and video
  • Lumina editor with block templates
  • Multilingual with AI translation
  • 13 configurable modules
  • 7 ready-made themes + template builder
  • Caching, recycle bin, versioning

Download AICMS and try it today!

title: Lumina Editor — Full Feature Overview
content:
Lumina Editor is the built-in WYSIWYG editor of AICMS, designed for convenient content creation.

What Lumina Can Do

  • Full text formatting: styles, colors, fonts, sizes
  • Tables with row and column management
  • Images and video with resizing
  • Block templates: hero sections, cards, accordions
  • AI assistant: generate text, photos, video
  • Toggle buttons "Read more / Collapse"
  • Sticky toolbar, fullscreen mode, auto-save
  • Source code mode with syntax highlighting
  • Module shortcodes directly in the editor

Lumina Editor is not just a text editor — it's a complete tool for creating professional web pages.

title: New Modules: Comments, Mini-Shop and Mini-Forum
content:
Three new modules have been added to AICMS with MySQL and SQLite support:

💬 Comments with Ratings

  • Comments on news and pages
  • 5-star rating system
  • Threaded replies
  • Moderation in admin: approve / spam / delete
  • Auto-detect news ID

🛒 Mini-Shop

  • Product catalog with categories
  • Product card with photo and description
  • Shopping cart (session-based, no registration)
  • Checkout with email notification
  • Product and order management in admin
  • Order statuses: new → paid → shipped → done

💬 Mini-Forum

  • Categories and topics
  • Create topics and replies (guest mode)
  • View and reply counters
  • Pinned topics
  • Avatars with initials

All modules use DB abstraction (PDO) and work with MySQL and SQLite. Tables are created automatically.

title: 7 Themes + Template Builder
content:
AICMS now includes 7 ready-made themes and a powerful template builder.

Ready-Made Themes

  • Helios — transparent navbar, lightbox, animations
  • Default — simple Bootstrap template
  • Modern — sticky navbar, clean design
  • Aurora — gradient hero, glassmorphism
  • Editorial — magazine layout with sidebar
  • Tech — dark theme with neon accents
  • Minimal — ultra-minimalism, single column

Template Builder

3 layouts × 6 color schemes × 5 fonts = 90 combinations. Create your own theme in 1 minute!

title: How to Install AICMS on a Hosting: Step-by-Step Guide
content:
AICMS installs on any regular PHP 7.4+ hosting in about 10 minutes. Here is the complete step-by-step guide: from uploading the archive to your first page.

Step 1. Upload to Hosting

  • Download the AICMS release (the aicms-release.zip archive).
  • Open your hosting control panel (cPanel, ISPmanager, DirectAdmin) and go to the File Manager.
  • Upload the archive to the site root (public_html or www) and extract it.
  • Alternatively, extract locally and upload via FTP (FileZilla) — the aicms/ folder must sit in the root.

Step 2. Folder Permissions

Make sure the web server can write to the following folders:

chmod -R 755 aicms/
chmod -R 775 aicms/data aicms/uploads aicms/admin/cache

Step 3. Run the Installer

Open https://your-site.ru/install.php in your browser and complete the 5-step installation wizard:

  1. Choose language — English or Russian.
  2. Requirements check — PHP 7.4+, json, session, mbstring extensions.
  3. Storage — JSON (no DB) or MySQL/SQLite for interactive modules.
  4. Site settings — name, theme, default language.
  5. Administrator — login and password for the admin panel.

After installation, be sure to delete install.php.

Step 4. First Login

Visit https://your-site.ru/admin/ and sign in with the administrator you created. You will see a dashboard with statistics. Create your first page: Pages → Create — and edit it in the Lumina editor.

What's Next

  • Create news — they will automatically appear in the feed on the homepage.
  • Enable modules: contact form, booking, shop.
  • Choose or generate a theme in the “Themes” section.
  • Configure SEO meta tags and enable caching in “Settings”.

title: Lumina Editor: Features and Management
content:
Lumina is the built-in WYSIWYG editor of AICMS where all content is created: pages, news, blocks. Here is how to manage it.

Toolbar

  • Text — bold, italic, H1–H4 headings, quotes, lists, colors, fonts.
  • Media — images (upload, URL, drag-and-drop), YouTube/Vimeo video.
  • Tables — insert, add/remove rows and columns.
  • Blocks — ready-made sections: hero, team cards, pricing, FAQ, accordions.
  • AI ✨ — generate text, images and video from a prompt.
  • Code — source code mode with syntax highlighting.

Management

  • Auto-save — the editor saves a draft every 30 seconds.
  • Read more / Collapse — a toggle button hides long content.
  • Fullscreen — handy for long articles.
  • Sticky toolbar — tools stay visible while scrolling.
  • History — undo/redo with change history.

Module Shortcodes

Insert module shortcodes right in the editor — they will be executed on the page:

{{module:contact_form|email=admin@site.com}}
{{module:latest_news|count=5}}
{{zone:sidebar}}

Text Animations

Select text and apply an animation: fade-in, glow, gradient, typewriter and more. The animations work on the live site too.
